question: The NNT or number of patients who must receive treatment to get one of them to present the event of interest is obtained:

options.opa: Dividing by two the relative risk decrease.
options.opb: Dividing by two the absolute reduction of risk.
options.opc: Obtaining the inverse of the relative risk reduction.
options.opd: Obtaining the inverse of the absolute risk reduction.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Relative risk decrease -> NNT calculation -> Dividing by two -> opa -> 80% CHAIN: Absolute risk reduction -> NNT calculation -> Dividing by two -> opb -> 85% CHAIN: Relative risk reduction -> NNT calculation -> Obtaining the inverse -> opc -> 90% CHAIN: Absolute risk reduction -> NNT calculation -> Obtaining the inverse -> opd -> 80%
analysis: The NNT is calculated by obtaining the inverse of the absolute risk reduction. It represents the number of patients who need to be treated for one additional patient to benefit from the treatment.
